## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest -q`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and
      `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has an entry under `## [Unreleased]` if a user would notice the change
- [ ] docs/architecture.md and docs/rules.md still describe the code
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`): I certify the DCO and accept the
      section "Rights in your contribution" of CONTRIBUTING.md (not needed for the
      maintainers listed in MAINTAINERS.md)
- [ ] If the change is substantial (a new module, rule, language or letter, or more than
      about 100 changed lines) or an organisation holds the rights in it, I have sent the
      signed form docs/assignment.md to hello@leichtfacile.ch
